title: RBI Proposed 1-Hour 'Golden Hour' Cooling-Off Window for Digital Transfers >₹10,000
summary: RBI discussion paper on digital payment safeguards suggests a 1-hour delay for first-time push payments >₹10k and annual credit cap of ₹25 lakh on mule accounts.

blocks.content: RBI published 'Discussion Paper – Exploring Safeguards in Digital Payments to Curb Frauds', recommending key structural friction measures to prevent fund dissipation.

items: **Cooling-Off Period**: 1-hour delay applied to account-to-account Authorised Push Payments (APP) exceeding **₹10,000** (accounting for 45% of fraud cases by volume and 98.5% by value).
**Mule Account Cap**: Annual credit limit capped at **₹25 lakh** for accounts flagged as potential money mules.
**Kill Switch**: Mandates user controls to toggle payment channels ON/OFF and activate instant kill switches.
